correctness.rationale: For every odd prime power q, K=F_{q²}, k=F_q, F(x)=x^{q+1}+x, choose a nonsquare d and ω²=d. The norm expansion F(a+bω)=(a²+a−db²,b) identifies the image V as the q(q+1)/2 points with u+db²+1/4 a square including zero. Indicator 1_V=(1+χ(z)+δ0(z))/2. Fourier transform for ξ≠0 is half ψ(−ξ/4)[1+G(ξ)] times a nondegenerate quadratic Gauss sum in b. The zero-first-frequency modes vanish except (0,0); G(ξ)=χ(ξ)G(1), |G|²=q and G(1)²=χ(−1)q. Thus |hat{1_V}(ξ,η)|²=q|1+χ(ξ)G(1)|²/4 and the q^-2 Fourier fourth-moment identity gives E(V)=[q²(q+1)^4+q(q−1)((q+1)²+2q(1+χ(−1)))]/16. Norm-extension and Gauss relations hold for all odd prime powers, not only primes. Independently enumerated image and ordered pair-sum counts for q=3,5,7, obtaining (|V|,E)=(6,150),(15,2095),(28,12712), each matching the universal formula. Original verify_energy.py field arithmetic was inspected for nonprime tests; finite checks alone do not prove the all-q result.
residual_risks: Odd prime powers only, no higher additive moments or even-characteristic claim; energy is ordered V^4.

The image of the natural finite-field norm-plus-identity polynomial has nonlinear parabolic-square fibers, and its exact energy exhibits an arithmetic split by χ(−1).
